title: ArcCivs native carried meals and paid Auto food buffer, 2026-10-28
assumptions: Low/base/high are independent illustrative city scenarios, not telemetry: 1/5/12 adult residents awake for 1/4/12 real hours/day; network participants 1/10/16 cities. Sleeping and absent time remains excluded.

Adult hunger drain remains1 per observed awake minute. Existing BREAD restores6, unchanged. Thus a bread-only steady diet consumes10 BREAD/resident-hour. Severe starting hunger0 uses3 existing bread in one observed session to reach18, never extra food credit.

Before Auto consumes1 abstract FOOD per bread-equivalent meal; after one existing FOOD converts into one real ordinary BREAD through a durable exact-container receipt. No conversion is possible with zero FOOD. Native pickup and eating never debit abstract FOOD a second time.

A single reachable public buffer holds a target4 real BREAD: staffed active TAVERN, otherwise active WAREHOUSE, otherwise hall; full/unloaded/inaccessible containers fall back honestly or leave FOOD untouched. One world admits at most one native item receipt per5s; conversion batch<=4, not the whole city reserve.

A resident takes up to4 existing plain food items only when hungry and no usable personal food remains. Existing personal/storage/container permissions remain authoritative. Tool slots, custom metadata, shipment cargo and actual profession ingredient reserves are excluded from autonomous eating.

One-time maximum initial exposure in the scenarios is4 public bread plus4 per resident=8/24/52 bread, backed by the same FOOD debit; reload does not regrant a stocked buffer. It is an inventory sensitivity, not a new recurring daily award.

The existing16 BREAD personal courier/home reserve is retained. For newly supported ordinary foods already in a bag,16 per material stays personal; actual profession ingredients are added separately for non-bread foods. This changes item routing/retention only, not creation, consumption nutrition, production or a price.

This is a new indirect item bridge: authorized native inventory access may move bread elsewhere and later sell it. Current sale prices, actual sell-through and live protection state were not measured; no monetary exchange rate or sale income is invented. Current SELL and planned SELL-to-contract transition remain separate.

Adversarial extraction is bounded by available earned FOOD and native room. The receipt cadence alone has an ideal4*720=2880 BREAD/world-hour ceiling shared by all cities, before travel, other receipts, finite stock and production. No new production rate or offline income is added.

Safe new ordinary EAT foods use exact Paper1.21.11 FOOD.nutrition plus CONSUMABLE duration; bread keeps its existing6. Native APPLE is4. Effectful food, remainder containers and custom components are excluded. Apple-only rows are an alternative diet sensitivity, not additive with bread-only rows.

Physical apple pickup moves an existing apple with exact native debit and bag credit. Eating burns that item and restores its captured native nutrition; it consumes zero abstract FOOD. Apple item sources and prices are unchanged.

Direct deltas are0 Vault,0 tokens and0 player XP separately. No price/progression cost changes, no invented savings time. Existing native-food/stock accounting, crash, partial/replay, fence failure and interruption checks are required; source tests do not prove runtime activation or client appearance.
